repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable foundations, shared operating rules, semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, frozen successor shell, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests and FIRE Knowledge. V6 remains production. G7 is 10/10 Locked and Frozen; approved shell runtime anchor is 4a258c5170dd1d96dcbc0f2b0a9c35b283cec489. FIRE Core breadboarding is unblocked and now explicitly observes ADR 0005's cross-app context boundary while remaining independently usable.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Lab is evidence, never authority. Active Fire/World experiments remain isolated from production runtime/data; there is no active full FIRE shell replica. Generic Lab chrome was reconciled to the validated Babel shell baseline in merge 46ff4a9a64578162af0ad30daea8439f04056830 and deployed successfully. Lab is now cleared to run the bounded WORLD Context Loop v0 experiment without turning the sandbox itself into World.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: World experiments currently live under babel-lab/world/. A real World product earns its own repo later; Babel Lab itself does not become World.
